value.rationale: Centralizer element rank is intrinsic to the symmetric inverse monoid, and a single univariate rank enumerator is substantially coarser data than the centralizer semigroup. Its provable completeness for the partition-parametrized nilpotent conjugacy classes is a natural algebraic rigidity theorem, not only a routine enumeration.
